correctness.rationale: For 256 length-four words a rational deletion-descendant weight of total 25 is at least one on every distinct descendant set. Exactly equality patterns 0000, 0011, 0120, 0123 are tight. A hypothetical 25-code would exactly partition all 64 length-three descendants using only tight types, but for each outer symbol its three nonconstant palindromes aba can be covered only in pairs by 0120 words, an impossible parity partition. Independently enumerated the 24 supplied length-four codewords and verified all 64 deletion outputs are pairwise disjoint and exhaust the universe, so 24 is attained. The universal upper-bound parity proof is symbolic, not inferred from enumeration.
